message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Rule | Details | |---|------|---------| | 1 | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a different agreed‑upon total). Points are earned when you finish a round by playing all your cards. | | 2 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Turn over the top card to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect before play begins. | | 3 | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). | | 4 | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches the discard pile’s **color**, **number**, or **symbol**. If you can’t play, you must draw from the draw pile. | | 5 | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction (acts as Skip if only two players).
• **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. (Can be challenged if you suspect the player had a matching color.) | | 6 | **Uno Call** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If another player catches you not saying “UNO” before they play a card, you must draw two penalty cards. | | 7 | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. | | 8 | **Scoring** | • The winner scores points equal to the sum of all cards left in opponents’ hands.
• Card values:
  – Number cards: face value.
  – Draw Two / Reverse / Skip: 20 points.
  – Wild / Wild Draw Four: 50 points.
• If the winner has a Wild Draw Four, they may add 100 bonus points. | | 9 | **Next Round** | Shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. Deal 7 cards again and start with the next player after the previous winner. | |10 | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the agreed‑upon point total (e.g., 500) wins. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | If a player receives a +2 or +4, they can play another +2/+4 on top of it, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative amount unless they stack further. | | **Seven-O** | Playing a 7 forces the next player to pick up 7 cards (or stack a +2). Playing an 0 swaps hands with the player opposite you. | | **Jump-In** | If you have an exact duplicate of the top card, you can play it immediately, even out of turn. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (e.g., Disney Uno) or create your own cards for house rules. | **Quick Play Tips** 1. Keep track of the colors that have been played to anticipate opponents’ options. 2. Hold onto Wild cards until you’re sure you’ll need them (e.g., when you’re down to two cards). 3. Use Draw Two/Draw Four strategically to block opponents who are close to winning. Enjoy your game!
